def shell_sort(arr):
    """
    This function performs Shell sort on the given array.
    Shell sort begins by sorting pairs of elements far apart from each other,
    then progressively reducing the gap between elements to be compared.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    gap = n // 2  # Initialize the gap.

    # Loop over the gaps
    while gap > 0:
        for i in range(gap, n):
            temp = arr[i]
            j = i
            # Shift elements of arr[0..i-gap] that are greater than temp
            # to index j, then put temp into its correct position
            while j >= gap and arr[j - gap] > temp:
                arr[j] = arr[j - gap]
                j -= gap
            arr[j] = temp
        gap //= 2  # Reduce the gap for the next iteration

    return arr
